question: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code.
sql:
SELECT 
  t15.geo_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr` t15
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
  ON t15.geo_id = t18.geo_id
WHERE t15.geo_id LIKE '06%'
  AND t15.median_income IS NOT NULL
  AND t18.median_income IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (t18.median_income - t15.median_income) DESC
LIMIT 1
